bullets.text: Chennai MRTS infrastructural gaps caused a woman's death which went unnoticed for four days, requiring the office to monitor transit safety.
In Thiruvallur, a man surrendered after killing his younger brother for allegedly sexually harassing his daughter, and the office should watch local fallout.

Residents in Thiruvallur protested against proposed new projects like a sewage treatment plant at the Tiruvartiyur burial ground, demanding district office action.
TANGEDCO scheduled temporary electricity disruptions in parts of Chennai and Thiruvallur including JJ Nagar and Avadi, which the district team should track.
IBM partnered with MeitY to boost India's deep-tech startups and outlined a vision for Digital Swaraj, aligning with portfolio goals.
HCLTech partnered with Anthropic to expand enterprise AI deployment with a focus on safety, cybersecurity, and governance controls.
Zoho skipped 2026 salary hikes due to surging AI infrastructure costs, with Sridhar Vembu noting a grim outlook for software jobs to watch.
DMK Parliamentary leader Kanimozhi wrote to the Union Minister regarding the removal of criticism posts against TVK on Instagram.
PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss criticized the government over ancestral land and patta issues concerning Pallikaranai, requiring close office watch.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Chennai to inaugurate Rs 13,000 crore projects including the Poonamallee to Vadapalani metro rail service.
Singapore Deputy Minister Gan Kim Yong is visiting Chennai on Thursday as Tamil Nadu is a key economic focus state for trade and industry.
